messages.text: Hi, my name is Helen and I'm putting together a memory book for the 50th reunion of the Central High class of 1976. I think you might have been in our class, or maybe I have the wrong person. If you were, I'd love to include a current photo and a short note about what you've been up to. No pressure at all!

Good morning! This is Riverbend Lawn & Garden. Thank you for being a customer last season. We're offering early sign-up for spring cleanups and mulching, and returning customers get 10% off if they book before February. Our team can stop by to give you a free estimate any weekday. Mom, someone shared this article about new Medicare changes for next year in my work group chat. I haven't had time to read it closely so I'm not sure if it's accurate, but it might be worth a look before we sit down to compare plans on Sunday: healthnewsdaily.example/medicare-2027-changes. Let's talk about it when I'm there.

Hello, I'm Pastor James from Grace Community Church on Hill Rd. Several members mentioned you might enjoy our Wednesday morning coffee group for seniors. We meet at 10 a.m. in the fellowship hall, and there are always fresh donuts and good conversation. No need to sign up, just come by whenever you like. Hope to see you soon!

Medicare Notice of Benefit Termination: Due to missing paperwork, your Part B coverage will end on the last day of this month. Many seniors are losing coverage because they did not respond in time. To keep your doctor visits covered, verify your identity now by replying with your full name, date of birth and Medicare number. A benefits officer will then confirm your continued enrollment.

To protect your retirement savings, we will help you move your money into a federally protected account. Do not tell anyone at your bank, as some employees are under investigation. Call 1-555-0123.

To have the refund deposited today, we just need to confirm your bank account number and routing number, plus a $75 filing fee that will be deducted from your refund. Reply YES to begin.

Please pay now to arrange delivery. Copy this address into your browser: usps[.]customs-clearance[.]top/pay. If you have already paid, kindly ignore this message. Thank you for shipping with us.

Dear First City Bank Customer, we are upgrading our online banking system this weekend. All customers must re-validate their accounts before Friday or online access will be suspended. Please follow the link below and sign in with your username, password and the code sent to your phone. https://firstcitybank-upgrade.net/validate. We thank you for your patience during this upgrade.

Hello, this is Amazon Gift Card Services. Our records show you were recently charged for $500 in Amazon gift cards. If you did not buy them, we can reverse the charge, but you must act quickly. Please call our reversal team at 1-800-555-0113. For your protection, have your card and online banking login ready so we can confirm the refund goes to the correct account.

Hello, this is David from your internet provider's security team. We have detected that hackers are using your Wi-Fi connection to access your bank account. To stop them we need to connect to your computer right away. Please go to quickconnect-help.co, download the tool, and tell me the nine-digit access code that appears on your screen. This is time sensitive, so please stay by your computer.

Hello my angel. I know we have only been talking for a few weeks, but I feel like I have known you all my life. I told my daughter all about you. I want to surprise you for Christmas, but my bank in Germany is blocking international transfers. If you could buy $800 in Google Play gift cards and send me the codes, I can use them to pay for my flight and visa.

Retirement Wealth Alert: A select group of seniors in your area has been invited to join a private gold and crypto investment club. Members have earned an average of 18% per month with zero risk, backed by a government insurance program. Only 12 spots remain and enrollment closes tonight. Secure your place by transferring $2,000 through Bitcoin ATM. Our advisor will confirm by phone.

Hello! We found your profile on a job site and would like to offer you a flexible part-time job helping online stores improve their ratings. You simply click to complete product orders on our platform and earn commissions of $150 to $800 per day. To activate your work account, you only need to make a starter deposit of $100 in USDT, which you can withdraw later with your earnings.

Hello, my name is Sergeant Wallace with the county police. I'm calling about your granddaughter Emma. She was a passenger in a car that was stopped for drugs, and although we believe she is innocent, she is being held until bond is paid. The judge has placed a gag order on this case, so please do not discuss it with family. Bond can be paid with gift cards from any store.
